facts.anchor: Elise buys a black cloth coat from a friperie in the Marais
facts.fact: 天气转冷，Elise 在玛黑区的一家旧衣店买了一件黑色布大衣。

facts.anchor: She will use two of the neutral leather masks. It will be a two-hander
facts.fact: 她要用两个中性皮革面具，把戏做成双人戏、却由她一人演出。

facts.anchor: She shakes her head. She’s doing it wrong. She tries to picture more people
facts.fact: 在“告别”练习中她摇头，试着多想象几个人，但脑中只有父亲。

facts.anchor: It’s been four days now and Elise hasn’t responded to any of her texts
facts.fact: 已过四天，Elise 不回母亲的短信和邮件，Catherine 的电话都直接转语音信箱。

facts.anchor: Her mom goes straight to the periphery, which is in the dark
facts.fact: 进场后她母亲径直走到场地边缘的暗处，Elise 看不见她。

facts.anchor: There was something very raw about it, very strong. But it had power over you.
facts.fact: 演出后 Tomas 说这段表演很原始、很强，但力量控制了她，她不是掌控体验的人；他还说这不能算表演。

facts.anchor: “Of course,” he says. “This was never in question.”
facts.fact: 她问自己是否还能留在项目里，Tomas 回答当然可以，这从来不是问题。

facts.anchor: She doesn’t see her mother there, she only sees herself, but she’s not herself anymore.
facts.fact: 演出结束后她在走廊镜子里看不到母亲，只看到自己，而她已经不是原来的自己。
